desc:
😡 Dev's Difficulty Chart Obby starts off easy, but it WILL get harder until you RAGE-QUIT!

Do you have what it takes to reach the end, or are you going to crash out? Every single stage tests your movement, and the final levels will push your skills to the absolute limit.

✅ All 200 stages are 100% possible! Only 0.1% of players have what it takes to beat the game. Prove you're one of them.

Controls:
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shift Lock (Shift, LT)
- Alignment Keys ( . and , )

👍 Leave a Like to support the game and unlock new updates!
👎 DISLIKE = CRASHOUT!
